incident.trigger: StateStore was instantiated against the protected production SQLite path during a guard check; the pre-fix guard accepted a legacy schema_migrations marker and auto-applied V4 migrations.

pre_incident_evidence.recorded_schema_note: legacy snapshot missing current runtime tables

recovery.method: Copied a clean old-schema template with the recorded production migration hash into an isolated recovery file, removed all non-migration rows in a local transaction, then replaced the production database after checking no daemon process held it.
recovery.structural_comparison: production and recovery source have identical table definitions, migration rows, row counts, and schema digest

controls_added_after_incident: StateStore now rejects any existing SQLite missing the complete current V4 required-table signature, even when schema_migrations exists.
Regression test covers an incomplete V4 snapshot with a legacy migration marker.
Future migration must be an explicit, separately auditable operation.

acceptance.note: Recovery is evidence-bounded logical restoration; it is not proof of browser acceptance or production cutover.
